metrics.mapping: experiments/tv_fresh.py read as hashed.  Per model, success matrices [task, state]; paired bootstrap B=2000, numpy default_rng(0), tasks and states drawn jointly; CI 2.5/97.5.  PRIMARY pi0.5 d = tvp - I on N1-N6: CONFIRMED iff d > .10 and CI lo > 0; REFUTED iff CI hi < .10; else UNRESOLVED.  GUARD pi0.5 tvp - I on K1-K4, K6: NO COST iff CI lo > -.10 (else COST NOT EXCLUDED).  SECONDARY GR00T tv - I on N1-N6 and pi0.5 tv - I on N1-N6: the primary's rule.  Descriptive only: the atlas's within / cross-chunk excess per arm (pp_atlas estimator, partners, stage rule unchanged); pi0.5 tvp - tv; tv K-task cost; stage shares; segmenter / paint / detector diagnostics; pi0.5 tvp against R2-retrain's main-state N1-N6 success .425 (SR 37.1; R2 was never run on fresh states, so unpaired and descriptive).  Harness checks reported: arm client args = I's except out/port/videos, per-episode trial/branch/variant/at = I's, I's excess reproduces pp_atlas_fresh_read.json, state and branch files match the hashes below.
metrics.prediction: PRIMARY pi0.5 tvp - I: CONFIRMED 65%, UNRESOLVED 30%, REFUTED 5%; point estimate +.25 to +.40 (regression from +.425).  GUARD NO COST 80%.  SECONDARY GR00T tv - I: CONFIRMED 35%, UNRESOLVED 50%, REFUTED 15%; pi0.5 tv - I: CONFIRMED 35%, UNRESOLVED 55%, REFUTED 10%.  pi0.5 tvp cross-chunk excess falls to near 0 (from I's +.450 on fresh states).
